_README: AGENT ATTRIBUTION + TAMPER-EVIDENCE REGISTRY.
Two agents work this repo concurrently. This file marks which regions each
one owns and records a SHA-256 of each region's exact source, so an edit to
someone else's region is VISIBLE and fails the build instead of sliding in.
owner: 'deepseek-flash' | 'aira-claude'  — who last authored the region
HOW IT IS ENFORCED: src/agentMarks.test.js re-derives every hash and fails
if a region changed or disappeared. A test is the part that matters — a
comment or a JSON file can always be quietly edited by anyone with write
access, so on its own a hash is tamper-EVIDENT, not tamper-PROOF. The suite
is what turns 'someone edited my code' into a red build.
IF YOU CHANGED A REGION ON PURPOSE: re-stamp it. That is one command, and it
lands in the diff as a deliberate, reviewable act:
node scripts/agent-marks.mjs --stamp
Verify without writing (what the test runs):
node scripts/agent-marks.mjs --verify
List the regions and owners:
node scripts/agent-marks.mjs --list
Regions are declared by ANCHOR, not by injected marker comments, on purpose:
injecting BEGIN/END comments would mean editing the other agent's code to tag
it, which is exactly the collision this registry exists to avoid.

regions.description: Collapsed short-form disclaimer + inline full-disclosure rollout. Short form must keep the legal hooks visible.
Click-open Tax Calculation Details modal. Reads the waterfall row only (rule 8) — no second tax computation.
Monte Carlo Advanced Settings dialog: paths, historical sampling range, return/cost assumptions, guardrails. Sole editable home for the model parameters.
Column-group segments for the year-by-year table. Span sum MUST equal the table's column count (24) or the grouped header misaligns.
Historical sampling window. Returns null for full history so an untouched profile reproduces the pre-feature behaviour byte-for-byte.
GK guardrail + the optional `out` sink that records cut/raise/longevity-hold. Additive: callers passing no sink get an identical number.
Aira-Claude's region: emits fedBrackets / deduction / fedOrdinary on each row for the Tax Details bracket analysis. Do not edit without re-stamping.
